locations.name: The Cirque du Shady

exterior.description: Old Town cobblestones give way to trampled grass and sawdust well before the gate itself is visible - the smell (fried sugar, machine oil, something floral gone slightly wrong) arrives first. A single wooden ticket booth flanked by a rope line that has never once needed to hold back a real crowd; a hand-painted arch overhead reads 'THE CIRQUE DU SHADY.' The big top itself is visible from streets away, a faded red-and-cream dome that has clearly not moved, in any literal sense, in a very long time.
exterior.entry_condition: Grounds open 14:00-01:00 daily; no stat, item, or previous-location requirements to enter.

interior.theme: A carnival grift ecosystem running at full vertical integration under one canvas dome that has not moved since 1997

functions: Central quest hub and attraction cluster tying together the Cirque's independently-profiled sub-locations (prize_booth, meat_cart_pitch, prophecy_tent, performance_circle)
Production-company front door for The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown (shady_productions_office, foreshadowing/pointer only)
Ambient performance district (performance_circle) and ICQ hotspot access (icq_backroom)
Light environmental storytelling for the Vanishing Elephant ('Bubbles') quest hook

quest_connections.note: Vance's beatdown_promo dialogue and the shady_productions_fax casting flyer both point the player toward Fauxst Beach on the Bohemian Riviera. The actual quest_origin (Petra at signup_table, debaucheryville_riverfront_bohemian_riviera_01) lives entirely there per bohemian_riviera_location_nodes.json and bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md - this is a pointer role only, not a second quest-start point.

quest_npc_vance_vallaro.description: Circus proprietor and Shady Productions owner-operator at big_top; hawks Shady Loot Crate vouchers and advertises the Beatdown.
quest_npc_vance_vallaro.mechanics: Sells the loot crate voucher (fulfilled at prize_booth) and triggers the beatdown_promo pointer event; does not administer Beatdown sign-up himself.

quest_npc_hamstradamus.description: Prophecy Roulette / doom-prophet performer at prophecy_tent, Cirque du Shady's most beloved act. Full profile in hamstradamus.md.
quest_npc_hamstradamus.mechanics: 5-coin Prophecy Roulette for a random buff/debuff. Absent from prophecy_tent on Beatdown filming days (relocated to Fauxst Beach as WIN-branch prize-giver).

event_hook_prophecy_roulette.mechanics: Full mechanics owned by hamstradamus.md; this is a grounds-level event hook registration only.

event_hook_beatdown_promo.description: Vance's spoken pitch for The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown at big_top / shady_productions_office.
event_hook_beatdown_promo.mechanics: Sets beatdown_aware state and routes the player toward Fauxst Beach signup_table on the Bohemian Riviera; grants no quest progress or reward on its own.

mini_game_knife_throw_dodge.description: Interactive dodge round at performance_circle's knife target board; the player takes Blanka's spot.
mini_game_knife_throw_dodge.mechanics: Full scoring, difficulty, and reward spec intentionally left as a hook, per cirque_du_shady.md Development Notes (deferred to a future pass, consistent with bohemian_riviera.md's treatment of night_party_zone).

shop_node_prize_booth.mechanics: Full prize-tier economy owned by the_participation_trophy.md - not modified here. Also fulfills Vance's Shady Loot Crate Voucher redemption.

shop_node_mystery_meat_cart.description: Chef Chuckles' cart, meat_cart_pitch zone, beside Vance's tent.
shop_node_mystery_meat_cart.mechanics: Full menu and Digestive Daredevil mechanics owned by mysterymeatcart.md - not modified here.

shop_node_game_alley.description: Rigged carnival games (milk bottles, ring toss, coin pusher) running parallel to the path toward prize_booth.
shop_node_game_alley.mechanics: Average yield 5-15 circus_tickets per EUR3 game, feeding directly into prize_booth's ticket-tier economy.

shop_node_vance_loot_crate_voucher.description: Vance's Shady Loot Crate Voucher pitch at big_top.
shop_node_vance_loot_crate_voucher.mechanics: Two-zone transaction: pitch and sale at big_top, fulfillment at prize_booth. Crate contents and fixed pricing intentionally deferred, per cirque_du_shady.md Development Notes.

npc_group_circus_crowd.description: 5-10 ambient grounds-wide crowd, highest density at main_gate and game_alley.
npc_group_circus_crowd.mechanics: Density and reaction-shot dressing; no unique persistent dialogue trees.

examinable_corkboard_flyers.description: Overlapping flyers at main_gate: Prophecy Roulette hours, the Bubbles missing-elephant poster, and a curling Shady Productions casting flyer.
examinable_corkboard_flyers.mechanics: Bubbles poster is a Vanishing Elephant sidequest hook (not designed here); casting flyer art is the same instanced asset as the fax machine's.

examinable_shady_productions_fax.description: Pre-millennium fax machine at shady_productions_office; periodically spits an identical Casting-Call Flyer.
examinable_shady_productions_fax.mechanics: Grants item_beatdown_casting_flyer and sets beatdown_aware on interaction; feeds the beatdown_promo quest_origin_pointer.

examinable_prize_pallet_2003_office.description: Shrink-wrapped merchandise pallet stamped 2003, visible at the tent-flap edge of shady_productions_office.
examinable_prize_pallet_2003_office.mechanics: Same physical merchandise stock as the Bohemian Riviera's pallet, split across two storage locations - environmental storytelling only.

hidden_area_icq_backroom.description: Second, unmarked canvas flap on the big top's opposite side, propped open a crack; a single CRT monitor glow visible after dark.
hidden_area_icq_backroom.mechanics: ICQ terminal hotspot; random Darkweb Dossier hack-through pop-ins, most likely after dark, sharing the same ICQ substrate and at least one handle (Tony420) with the ICQ Scammer Sting questline cross-referenced in bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md.
